testPlan.title: Junction: a new road-runs T gets the mod's T first time

test.title: The game loaded this test version
test.hint: This ticks by itself. Nothing to do.

test.title: A new two-lane T: clear + build
test.passLog: a new junction %(no number yet.*the mod's T fitted
test.failLog: the mod pattern won't fit here
test.hint: Lay a new two-lane side road onto a two-lane road with road runs (no turns, no number). Lock it (card: junction: new). Right-click. Ticks by itself.

test.title: It is the mod's T
test.hint: Look at the T you just built. It is the mod's T pattern, not separate curved turns. PASS if so.

test.title: Undo puts it back
test.hint: Press undo once. The side road is back as road runs left it. PASS if so. Redo if you want to keep it.
